bio.text: David Siffert advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for New York State Assembly District 66 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

According to their campaign website, Siffert is a civil rights lawyer and NYU law professor whose work includes serving as Legal Director of the Surveillance Technology Oversight Project, and is founding Executive Director of NYU's State Government Initiative.

Siffert graduated from the University of Chicago in 2006 and NYU Law School in 2009, according to Ballotpedia citing a candidate survey, and the campaign site says Siffert is a life-long Manhattanite who lives in the East Village.
